'''Ritton''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] that was in charge of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Vanguard (Imperial-class)|''Vanguard'']] around the time of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].
